import html # Predefined template for the user profile display. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{username}

{biography}

{status}
""" def generate_user_profile(username: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. biography : str A user‑written biography that may span multiple sentences. status : str A brief, current status message provided by the user. Returns ------- str The profile string with all user input safely escaped for HTML. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Basic type checking to avoid unexpected errors if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username, biography, status)): raise TypeError("All arguments must be of type str.") # Escape user input to neutralize potential XSS payloads safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_biography = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, biography=safe_biography, status=safe_status )
